name: playwright-chrome
description: Control the user's real Chrome or Edge profile through Playwright MCP, with a simple guided installation and extension-token setup flow.

interface.shortDescription: Use or quickly set up Playwright MCP for Chrome.
interface.longDescription: Uses Playwright MCP in extension mode to operate the user's real Chrome or Edge profile. The bundled Agent Skill supports both Codex and Claude Code with host-specific installation, invocation, and MCP configuration flows. New users get concise usage examples and guided setup without echoing the extension token.
